provenance_quote: The lipase and muramidase T6SS effectors identified in this study underscore the diversity of T6SS-secreted substrates and the distinctly different mechanisms that target these for secretion by the dynamic T6SS organelle.
notes: DOI 10.1073/pnas.1222783110 = Dong et al 2013 PNAS (PMID 23362380, PMC3574944), resolves via Crossref. UniProt Q9KS43 live = Toxin TseL, gene tseL, OLN VC_1418, V. cholerae N16961; annotated "Toxin secreted by the type VI (T6SS) secretion system" and "Delivered to the target cell by the T6SS in a VgrG3-dependent pathway". Ledger locus VC_RS06860 is the RefSeq tag for VC_1418. Secretion of TseL (lipase effector) supported by abstract + UniProt.

notes: DOI 10.1073/pnas.1222783110 = Dong et al 2013 PNAS (PMID 23362380), resolves.
